name: Brick Hedz
description: “BRICK HEDZ” is a visually striking art series brought to life by artist Brick Ross. Each piece is meticulously hand drawn in procreate and now immortalized on the Bitcoin blockchain. This collection pays homage to many influential artists, public figures and meme culture while incorporating controversial subjects using the iconic symbol of the well known candy dispenser from many of our childhoods. Within these artworks lie timeless tales of historical significance, hidden meanings and cryptic messages while invoking mystery and imagination from the viewer that will endure through the ages.
